title: Why branches?
concept: Try an idea without breaking main; git branch

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: We need to add a map to the site, but we can't break the main page.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: A **branch** is a safe place to try an idea. `git branch` lists your branches.

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Type `git branch map` to make a new branch named map.

items.text: Create a new branch called map

hints: Use the `git branch` command with the name of the new branch.
Type `git branch map` and press Enter.
recap: `git branch <name>` creates a new branch pointing to your current commit.
